'''Danteel City Police''' was a law enforcement agency that operated in [[Danteel City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danteel]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Danteel City Police investigated the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Carisica Vanq]], and the police [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Stenberk]] arrested the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Darim Chumu]] in the [[High Card Casino]] on suspicion of committing the crime.
